GAOSHOU_EVENT_SMITE_MASTER.title: Strike Master
GAOSHOU_EVENT_SMITE_MASTER.pages.INITIAL:
I had just come out of a fight, taking the monsters down with a few Strikes in a row.
Then I heard an old master's voice from afar: “Kids these days just don't respect the Strike! Your Strikes are absolutely dreadful!”
“Come here and let the Strike Master teach you what a real Strike is!”
Show me what a top-tier Strike looks like!
Master, teach me the ultimate secret of the Strike!
No way, I want nothing to do with Strikes!
“Good, good! You picked up the essence of the Strike in no time!” the Strike Master says with satisfaction.
“Just don't let the basic Strikes slip your mind in a few days, or I'll be very sad!”
GAOSHOU_EVENT_SMITE_MASTER.pages.DONE.de: The Strike Master waves me off.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GUARD_MASTER.title: Guard Master
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GUARD_MASTER.pages.INITIAL:
“Blocking is the best! Strikes are garbage!”
From far off I could hear a big guy roaring while he drilled the most basic Block. Then he noticed me.
“Come practice basic Blocking with me! Blocking is the greatest!”
Upgrade 2 random [gold]Strike[/gold] or [gold]Defend[/gold] cards. Obtain 1 [gold]Defend[/gold] card.
Your Blocking is impressive. Teach me!
I used to look down on Strikes too, but an old master taught me…
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GUARD_MASTER.pages.TRAINED:
We drilled basic Blocking for a while and worked up a good sweat.
The big guy patted my shoulder and told me to come back tomorrow.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GUARD_MASTER.pages.ENLIGHT: I told him about the Strike Master's lessons. He listened and said: “So the Strike runs that deep... Striking and Blocking both matter. I get it now!”
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GUARD_MASTER.pages.DONE.de: I left smelling of sweat, one small insight heavier.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ROADSIDE_BENCH.title: Roadside Bench
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ROADSIDE_BENCH.pages.INITI:
By the roadside I see a few cabinets set side by side and one big table, covered in tinkering tools. Basic, but plenty for some pleasant modification work.
Beside them sit spikes that add damage, and padded linings that add defense.
Choose 1 card and give it [gold]Slumbering Essence[/gold] 1.
Modifications done, I packed up the tools and dusted off my hands.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ODD_JOBS.title: Odd Jobs
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ODD_JOBS.pages.INITIAL.des: There's a little shop here that handles every kind of odd job. Fortune telling, mending shoes, cutting keys — no problem at all.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ODD_JOBS.pages.INITIAL.opt: Costs [red]{TrainCost}[/red] Gold. I can't afford it.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_ODD_JOBS.pages.DONE.descri: The owner waves me off and says I'm welcome back anytime.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MAGIC_PRODIGY.title: Magic Prodigy
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MAGIC_PRODIGY.pages.INITIA:
I passed a small school of magic and heard a professor shouting as he hurled a student out the door: “You really are a magic prodigy — what a disaster this school has picked up!”
The student spotted me outside and hurried over to pitch his original spells: “My spells are far too advanced. Nobody in this world could possibly understand them!”
Teach me this Punching the Air
Teach me your way of thinking
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MAGIC_PRODIGY.pages.DONE.d: I pocketed my new spell notes and left the school behind.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GRAND_LIBRARY.title: Grand Library
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GRAND_LIBRARY.pages.INITIA:
I passed by a really grand library!
Maybe I can go in and look for a good book, or donate some things I don't need.
Borrow some books! I'll return them if I get the chance.
Choose up to 2 of 20 random cards to add to your deck.
Donate something — seems you get a little gift in return!
Remove 1 card and obtain 1 random Relic.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_GRAND_LIBRARY.pages.DONE.d: I closed the library door gently behind me and walked on.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_SUPER_UPGRADER.title: Super Upgrader
GAOSHOU_EVENT_SUPER_UPGRADER.pages.INITI:
I spot a vending machine with a sign above it that reads “Super Upgrade Machine”.
It seems a small price buys a chance to grow stronger — with no limits at all!
Lose [red]{GoldCost}[/red] Gold. 40% chance to Upgrade 1 random upgradable card.
Lose [red]{HpCost}[/red] HP. 40% chance to Upgrade 1 random upgradable card.

GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_CAVE.title: Mysterious Cave
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_CAVE.pages.INIT: I see a dark, gloomy cave. It looks dangerous, but maybe it's worth exploring?
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_CAVE.pages.DEEP: Found some good stuff, but there seems to be a deeper part left to explore.
Gain a card reward. Lose [red]{CaveHp}[/red] HP.

Not bad — even more good stuff!

Looks like the bottom of the cave is just a little further ahead.
Scored some real treasure! Not bad.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_CAVE.pages.DONE: I climbed out of the cave with an armful of loot; it was dark outside by then.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_SHOP.title: Mysterious Shop
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_SHOP.pages.INIT:
Ahead I see a gaudy little tent with a big, portly merchant standing outside.
“Oh! Welcome to the Mysterious Shop. We only sell the very best!”
Lose [red]{BuyCardsCost}[/red] Gold. Gain a Rare card reward.
Lose [red]{BuyUncommonCost}[/red] Gold. Obtain 1 random Uncommon Relic.
Lose [red]{BuyRareCost}[/red] Gold. Obtain 1 random Rare Relic.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_SHOP.pages.DONE: The merchant grinned as he saw me out of the tent.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_STRANGE_TEMPLE.title: Strange Temple
GAOSHOU_EVENT_STRANGE_TEMPLE.pages.INITI: Deep in the thicket stands a temple. It looks like bad news. But there might be something good inside!
Go in and see if there's anything good!
I hurried out of the thicket with a chill down my back.
GAOSHOU_EVENT_MYSTERIOUS_SHOP.pages.NO_G:
I turned my pockets inside out and a few pitiful coppers rolled across the counter.
The merchant's grin faded a little. "...Come back once you can afford it."
Next time, with a full purse
